title: Quakeklan
wikitext:
Where unexpected things happen!

== History ==
Started up in late [[2007]], [[fog|Dimman]] got recruited and started to headhunt for new members. When a full lineup was established, [[Ernst]] and [[Motorized]] went inactive. Signed up for Bronze Cup in [[NQR11]], ending up taking the 2nd place after losing a tight final vs [[Nafianna]].

Quakeklan then split up into 2 teams for the [[EQL Season 7]] (initial plans were 3 teams, but rookie-team, [[Quakeklan.b]], went inactive): Quakeklan 1 and [[Quakeklan 2]].

In [[2010]] [[fog|Dimman]], [[ok98]] and [[Lethalwiz]] left Oblivion and started Quakeclan again with old quakeclan player [[TheEvilDog]]. Together with [[Overdose]], [[Votary]] and [[Striker]]. [[Striker]] left the clan to [[Slackers]] after some games and [[Overdose]] and [[Votary]] left after [[EQL Season 12|EQL12]]
